lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, circular white blobs are distributed posterior to the gill slits. Three primary local maxima form an obtuse scalene triangular arrangement situated dorsal to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible across the flank, intersecting horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs to create a perceptible grid-like pattern in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent longitudinal ridge runs horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow on the ventral edge.
